home.baristaNote: The point of sale arrives in the next release. You are logged in as a barista.

products.label: Size
products.saveFirst: Save the product to add sizes and prices.
products.noGroups: No modifier groups yet. Create them under Modifiers.

ingredients.unitLocked: The unit cannot change after creation.
ingredients.note: Stock quantities are changed only through opening balances and adjustments.

inventory.deltaHint: Use a negative number to remove stock.
inventory.countHint: The system computes the difference from the current balance.
inventory.openingNote: Opening balances can be entered once per ingredient, before any other stock movement.
inventory.openingInvalid: Quantities must be numbers greater than 0.

users.resetNote: The user will be logged out of all devices.

settings.taxRateInvalid: Tax rate must be a number between 0 and 100.

errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.LAST_ADMIN: The last active admin cannot be deactivated or demoted.
errors.CANNOT_DEACTIVATE_SELF: You cannot deactivate your own account.
errors.OPENING_BALANCE_EXISTS: An ingredient already has stock movements, so an opening balance cannot be set.
errors.SHIFT_NOT_OPEN: You need an open shift for this. Open one at the point of sale.
errors.SHIFT_ALREADY_OPEN: You already have an open shift.
errors.PRICE_CHANGED: The price changed. Review the new total.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED: The request is missing its safety key. Reload the page.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This request key was already used for a different sale.
errors.INVALID_QUANTITY: Quantity must be a whole number from 1 to 99.
errors.ITEM_UNAVAILABLE: An item in the cart is no longer available.
errors.INVALID_MODIFIER: An option in the cart is not available for this product.
errors.MODIFIER_SELECTION_INVALID: Check the number of options chosen.
errors.PAYMENT_MISMATCH: The payments do not add up to the total.
errors.PURCHASE_NOT_EDITABLE: A posted purchase cannot be edited or deleted.
errors.EXPENSE_NOT_VOIDABLE: This expense cannot be voided (purchase expense, already voided, or its shift is closed).

recipe.title: Recipe
recipe.help: What one unit of this size consumes. Waste % is added once. Give a line a slot (e.g. milk) so a replace group (e.g. Oat Milk) can swap it.
recipe.empty: No ingredients: this size will not deduct any stock.
recipe.pickIngredient: Choose an ingredient on every line.
recipe.wasteInvalid: Waste must be a number from 0 to 100.
recipe.slotInvalid: A slot uses letters, numbers, - or _ only.
recipe.slotMissing: The group “{{group}}” replaces the slot “{{slot}}”, but this recipe has no line with that slot.

modifiers.help: Reusable option groups. Link them to products on the product page.
modifiers.saveFirst: Save the group to add options.
modifiers.slotHint: The slot key used in recipes, e.g. milk.
modifiers.slotWarningsText: These sizes have no recipe line with the slot “{{slot}}”, so selling this group with them fails
modifiers.label: Option
modifiers.sizePricesHint: Overrides the extra price for one size.
modifiers.effectsHint: What this option consumes. “All sizes” applies when a size has no row of its own. An option with no rows changes nothing (a replace group then removes the slot, e.g. No milk).

pos.cartEmpty: Add products to start an order.
pos.tenderedShort: The cash received is less than the total.
pos.cardNote: Charge the card on the terminal first.
pos.mixedInvalid: Cash must be more than 0 and less than the total.
pos.checkingText: Please wait. Do not take payment again.
pos.unconfirmed: Could not confirm the last sale. Do not take payment again. Check the connection, then tap Retry. Selling is paused until it is confirmed.
pos.priceChangedText: Prices changed since you built this order. Review the new total, then take payment again.
pos.noShift: No open shift. Open your shift to start selling.
pos.openShiftText: Count the cash in the drawer and enter it to start your shift.
pos.lowStock: Low stock (the sale still goes through):
pos.noPaymentNeeded: No payment needed for a 0.00 order.

orders.baristaNote: Today's orders. Search an invoice number to find an older one.
orders.refundUnsure: We could not confirm the refund. Do not refund again by hand: tap Retry to check.
orders.refundCardWarning: Card refunds must be done on the card terminal by staff.
orders.refundCashNote: The cash is taken from your open shift.
orders.refundStockWarning: Stock is not returned. An Admin can adjust stock if the item is reusable.

shift.shortage: Shortage: the drawer has less cash than expected.
shift.overage: Overage: the drawer has more cash than expected.
shift.closeText: Count the cash in your drawer and enter it. You cannot sell after closing.
shift.closeOther: You are closing {{name}}'s shift. Enter the cash counted for it.
shift.goPos: Open a shift at the point of sale

expenses.drawerNote: Paid in cash from your drawer. It lowers your expected cash and needs your open shift.
expenses.voidNote: Voiding removes it from reports and from an open shift's expected cash. It cannot be undone.

purchases.postedNote: Posted {{time}} by {{by}}. Stock and the expense were recorded once.
purchases.rowInvalid: Each item needs an ingredient, a quantity and a cost.
purchases.drawerNote: A drawer purchase uses your own open shift when you post.
purchases.packHint: By pack: pack count × pack size = quantity; the cost per unit is the pack cost ÷ pack size.
purchases.postWarning: Posting adds the stock and records an expense of {{total}}. It cannot be undone or edited.
purchases.postUnsure: We could not confirm the post. Tap Retry: it is safe, it will not post twice.

reports.stockNote: Balances are current. The date range only affects the consumed column.
